items.title: Local OCR for blocked documents
items.oneliner: Chrome extension extracts text from scanned PDFs locally with Tesseract, so you can paste clean text into LLMs.

items.title: Run Qwen on 16GB VRAM
items.oneliner: Hands-on llama.cpp guide shows quantization and flags to run Qwen3.8-27B on a single 16GB RTX 3080.

items.title: A better agent.md template
items.oneliner: Practical agent.md template tightens LLM coding style, cuts boilerplate, and makes generated code easier to review.

items.title: One server for many models
items.oneliner: Open-source inference server runs embeddings, rerankers, extraction, and generation models behind one endpoint with on-demand loading.

items.title: Parquet dashboards without a backend
items.oneliner: Build fast drilldown dashboards from one 40MB Parquet file using HTTP range requests and an 18KB reader.

items.title: Free certificate transparency search
items.oneliner: Certificate transparency search engine supports regex queries across massive CT logs for phishing, squatting, and infra hunting.

items.title: Add JIT to an interpreter
items.oneliner: Step-by-step libgccjit tutorial adds JIT compilation to a toy stack interpreter, including recursive factorial execution.

items.title: Declarative WebGPU packaging runtime
items.oneliner: S-expression WebGPU runtime packages shaders and pipeline config into one shareable file, with validation before execution.

items.title: Highlight forum users with CSS
items.oneliner: CLI generates custom CSS from a TOML username list so Lobsters and Tildes feel more like Reddit.

items.title: A tiny vi-like editor
items.oneliner: Minimal open-source editor offers vi-style navigation in a lightweight package you can fork, study, and extend.
